machine: AMD Ryzen 9 9900X, one Chromium process per width, production unminified bundle, CDP sampling interval 100 µs
workload: repeated small runs: width 1 profiles 160 runs of 256 one-row roots, width 128 profiles 96 runs of 32 roots (diagnose.mjs --modes=ranvier-template,solid --phases=mount,dispose --repeat); host creation, preparation and cleanup are excluded
note: Busy time is the time inside the timed run, including the garbage-collector samples between its JavaScript samples. Categories: view = Ranvier.View.Foundation or @solidjs/web; core = src/Ranvier or @solidjs/signals; fixture = FrameworkPerf.js, page.mjs or the compiled solid.jsx (Solid's row template code lives there); dom = native DOM time, attributed to the nearest categorized caller; library = fable-library time attributed to its caller. Self and inclusive times map each frame through the bundle's source map.
